svg.title: First-token delivery delay of each run, by stream API
svg.desc: A dot chart on a log scale of the time between the stub sending the first token and the consumer seeing it, on the Mac, 50 runs per API. Medians: plain openai 0.68 ms, ChatOpenAI 0.8 ms, messages mode 0.68 ms, v3 docs loop 1.16 ms, and the async v3 consumer that reads reasoning first 935.06 ms.
svg.text: milliseconds from send to the consumer, log scale
Each dot is one run of 40 tokens from the stub, 50 runs per API. The tall tick is the median.
The rose row loops over message.reasoning before message.text, so the text waits for the end.
